answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The sonnet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the walnut. What survives to the timber is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, slashed on a failed audit, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
